snippet.title: exA-Arcadia『アクウギャレット EXA LABEL』| AIRGALLET EXA LABEL for Arcades | Attract Video | Vertical
snippet.description:
AIRGALLET EXA LABEL for Arcades on exA-Arcadia
Available Now

Players: 1-2
Genre: Shooter
Monitor: Vertical (Recommended), Horizontal
Languages: English, Japanese

FEATURES

2 PLAYABLE SHIPS
Choose from the Japanese Self Defense Force F-15XX or US Air Force F/A 18G

1 FRAME INPUT LAG RESPONSE – twice as fast as the arcade version and the fastest benchmark in the game industry

2 PLAY MODES
ORIGINAL MODE – 100% accurate port of the 1996 original version
EXA LABEL MODE – a complete reimagining of the game focused on medal scoring and weapon usage 

Extreme Difficulty and Score Attack Mode are now available in each play mode.

GADGETS
In either screen orientation (vertical or horizontal), newly designed gadgets can be toggled and repositioned as desired

2 SOUNDTRACKS
ORIGINAL – the arcade original soundtrack now in HD stereo
EXA ARRANGE – the new arranged soundtrack composed by Keishi Yonao

NEW VOICES
Every character and story sequence is now fully voiced by renowned ’90’s anime voice actors!

CAST
KEIICHIRO TOJO – MASAMI KIKUCHI
JOHNNY GLOVER – TETSUYA IWANAGA
COMMANDER – URARA TAKANO
& more

OPERATE IN LANDSCAPE OR PORTRAIT
Works in either screen orientation (vertical or horizontal).

LEARN MORE ➡️ https://bit.ly/42629PK
SUBSCRIBE ➡️ https://www.youtube.com/@exa-arcadia?view_as=subscriber?Sub_Confirmation=1
